final: WITH g AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), sh AS (SELECT g.order_id, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / s.total AS share FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.cnt), AVG(sh.share), AVG(sh.share - a.avg_share) FROM sh JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE sh.share > a.avg_share
